about_the_game:
Great Harvester

A farming sim… with a body count.

Your life in the town of Great Harvest should have been peaceful. Instead, you find your husband brutally murdered. Worse? The town locks you away in a loony bin.

Now, one year later, you’re back to rebuild your life as a humble farmer… or are you? When the Devil shows up, he brings an offer. So, if you want revenge, it looks like your going to have to learn to harvest more than just corn.

Key Features:

  • Farm by day, murder by night – Build your farm by planting crops, raising livestock and decorating your home. Help the community by beautifying the town, doing quests and making small talk with the lovely townsfolk… all before turning them into compost.

  • Combat – Kill with whatever you have on hand. An axe? Brutal. A shovel? Effective. A bag seeds? Hope you have a backup plan.

  • Stealth and strategy matter – Kill too recklessly, and the cops will be on your trail. Dispose of bodies, destroy evidence, eliminate witnesses, and don’t get caught!

  • A deal with the Devil… or a loophole with an Angel? – Satan isn’t the only one with an interest in the souls of your town. Maybe you can weasel your way out of eternal damnation yet...

  • Sinful romances – Flirt with the Devil… Bewitch an Angel. Or both!

  • Journey through Hell – Descend through the nine circles of hell.

  • A darkly comedic story – In a town full of quirky, oblivious characters, discover the dark secret behind your husbands murder and "deal" with those who stand in your way.

Will you fulfill your contract and take revenge? Will you find a way to the final circle of hell? Either way, get ready to reap what you sow.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes Frequent depictions of cartoon violence.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 / AMD A8-7600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 / Radeon HD 7770
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: After your husband’s murder, the Devil shows up with a deal you can’t refuse. So if you want revenge, it looks like soul harvesting season has just begun. Farm by day, kill by night, and don’t get caught. Congratulations! You’re now the town’s serial killer.
